outlook.name: Corn
lines: USDA October yield 181.2 bu/ac vs 178.5 in September (+1.5%). Since 2006 the final yield has come in above the October number in 47% of years, average -0.55%, typical miss ±1.54%.
Sep → Oct 2026: national 178.5 → 181.2; biggest state contributions NE +1.19, SD +0.40, KS +0.30 bu/ac.
Current forecast is -4.6 bu/ac (-2.5%) vs the 1986+ linear trend (185.8).
2026/27 ending stocks 1,849 m bu (USDA Oct 2026) vs 1,567 (USDA Sep 2026); stocks/use 11.3%.
Price vs tightness (November avg of the new-crop contract, R² 0.75): USDA S/U 11.34% maps to $4.54; ZCZ2026 at $4.40 is below it and prices S/U of 11.91% (market looser than USDA).
Export sales week 9: commitments-based projection 2,301 m bu (range 1,960–2,947) vs USDA 3,300, below USDA. YTD commitments 24.79 MMT vs 37.36 a year ago.
Managed money net -2.9 MMT (-10.0 w/w), 31st percentile since 2006.
Z26/Z27 spread -44.75c vs a -31.8c median at this time of year (21st percentile).

outlook.name: Soybeans
lines: USDA October yield 53.1 bu/ac vs 52.8 in September (+0.6%). Since 2006 the final yield has come in above the October number in 68% of years, average +0.48%, typical miss ±1.92%.
Sep → Oct 2026: national 52.8 → 53.1; biggest state contributions IL +0.24, OH +0.17, ND +0.16 bu/ac.
Current forecast is +0.5 bu/ac (+0.9%) vs the 1986+ linear trend (52.6).
2026/27 ending stocks 315 m bu (USDA Oct 2026) vs 310 (USDA Sep 2026); stocks/use 6.9%.
Price vs tightness (October avg of the new-crop contract, R² 0.8): USDA S/U 6.87% maps to $11.61; ZSX2026 at $11.83 is above it and prices S/U of 6.53% (market tighter than USDA).
Export sales week 9: commitments-based projection 1,992 m bu (range 1,737–2,433) vs USDA 1,695, above USDA. YTD commitments 30.23 MMT vs 17.2 a year ago.
Managed money net +18.1 MMT (-7.2 w/w), 77th percentile since 2006.
X26/X27 spread -0.5c vs a -1.1c median at this time of year (53rd percentile).

outlook.name: Soybean complex: Brazil, Argentina, US crush
lines: Argentina soybean crush 26/27 through month 5 of the Apr/Mar season: 20.3 Mt vs 19.0 a year earlier (+7%, MAGyP). Meal stocks 0.68 Mt at the latest month-end.
Brazil soybean exports Jan–Oct 2026: 106.5 Mt vs 100.6 in 2025 (+6%, Comex Stat).
US soybean crush 26/27 season-to-date (1 month, NASS to 2026-09): 199 m bu vs 205 a year earlier (-3.0%); meal yield 44.23 lb/bu, oil 11.58 lb/bu (trailing 12 months).
